settings.title: Every message, routed exactly where it’s meant to land.

settings.editor: From a single one-time passcode to a wholesale route carrying millions of messages a day, we build the connection and stay out of your way.
Application-to-person delivery built for speed — one-time passcodes, banking alerts, and marketing campaigns land in real time, at deliverability rates carriers can vouch for.
Direct operator connections and premium routes for carriers and aggregators moving serious volume — without trading away delivery quality.
SMPP binds and REST APIs, TLS-secured end to end, backed by live traffic monitoring and an engineering desk that answers at 3am the same as 3pm.
Bulk campaigns, customer communications, and real-time reporting, unified in one platform built for teams operating at scale.

settings.title: Built for the businesses that can’t afford a dropped message.

settings.editor: Strategic routes spanning Asia, Africa, Europe, LATAM, and the Middle East.
Direct operator routes mean your messages land faster, and more reliably.
Wholesale pricing structured to protect your margin at any volume.
Trusted carrier partnerships, worldwide, with low latency by design.
Encrypted connections and fraud detection, running on redundant systems.
A real person for onboarding, optimization, and everything after.

settings.title: A messaging partner built on carrier relationships, not just software.

settings.editor: Text Telecom is a global telecommunications company specializing in SMS messaging and mobile communication infrastructure — connecting businesses, aggregators, and operators through delivery that’s reliable, secure, and built to scale worldwide.
Give every business a direct, dependable line to its customers, anywhere in the world.
Become a trusted global name in mobile messaging through service quality, technology, and partnerships that last.
A 99.9% uptime SLA — our network doesn’t sleep.
Clear pricing and honest reporting — no surprises, ever.
Your growth is the metric we optimize for first.
Reach out to our team — we typically reply within one business day.
